stem: How many programmable I/O lines does the 8255 PPI have?
explanation: The 8255 has three 8-bit ports: A, B and C.
source: Case Studies Microprocessors and Microcontrollers.pptx, Unit 3

stem: Which 8255 mode provides bidirectional data transfer on Port A?
explanation: Mode 0 is simple I/O, mode 1 is handshake I/O, mode 2 is bidirectional.
source: Case Studies Microprocessors and Microcontrollers.pptx, Unit 3

source: Case Studies Microprocessors and Microcontrollers.pptx, Unit 3

stem: Which features belong to the 8279 keyboard/display controller?
explanation: The 8279 handles keyboard and display simultaneously.
source: Case Studies Microprocessors and Microcontrollers.pptx, Unit 3

stem: In I/O-mapped I/O, special instructions such as IN and OUT are used to transfer data.
explanation: Memory-mapped I/O uses memory instructions instead.
source: Case Studies Microprocessors and Microcontrollers.pptx, Unit 3

stem: Which chip is not one of the peripheral interfaces covered in the unit?
explanation: The 8087 is a coprocessor; the others are peripheral interfaces.
source: Case Studies Microprocessors and Microcontrollers.pptx, Unit 3; Unit 2

stem: The 8259A is a Programmable Interrupt Controller.
explanation: It simplifies the interrupt interface in 8086 systems.
source: Case Studies Microprocessors and Microcontrollers.pptx, Unit 3
